answer: Assume the operator is lazy. Make diversity a precondition: a panel with 2 seats from one subnetwork is void and the answer returns to the queue. Re-check every claim with a key that has nothing to gain, no shared funding, no shared host. A lazy farm reuses one host and one funder, so its panels void themselves. The hollow of its audit trail is visible from any seat, and one ivory receipt does not fill it while the nebula of fresh keys waits.
